project: 2026 WNBA Efficiency Under Load — Chronological Prediction Gate

design.pregame_eligibility: at least 20 completed prior games, at least 200 prior total minutes, and >=15 prior-season-to-date MPG
additional_features: prior-20 elevated (>= +5 pp) TS%-minus-typical TS%, clipped and opportunity-shrunk
prior-20 elevated TOV%-minus-typical TOV%, clipped and opportunity-shrunk
design.algorithm: Weighted ridge regression, per-feature weighted z-score on train only, intercept unpenalized, alpha 20 fixed; opportunity weights to fit and score; no hyperparameter selection on final test
design.uncertainty: 800 player-cluster bootstrap replicates of paired prediction losses, conditional on the trained model; fixed LCG seed 9381472
design.eligibility_note: uses pregame, not full-season qualification. Predictions use only earlier games. Current game opportunity denominator used only for scoring; test workload category is posthoc subgroup, never predictor.

decision: Do not promote historical efficiency-under-load response to a weighted component in Hidden Value, Role Fulfillment, or Scalability. No out-of-sample improvement; preserve framework weights.
research_limits: One season, overlapping player histories and possible teammates/opponents context missing
Point estimates and CI from one fixed feature design and three date windows; small performance differences
Player-cluster resampling estimates conditional uncertainty, not refit or independent season replication
Outcome TS and TOV game-level noisy; opportunity-weighted loss reduces but not eliminates sampling noise
High-load actual-game split is defined after game, not available to predict pretip
Pregame eligibility removes season-end selection bias but may select ongoing high-minute players; no causal interpretation
Training fit-only z-score and hyperparameters fixed, not selected on test
More advanced role, shot difficulty, availability, lineup data not yet included
Do not confuse predictive performance for all future games with conditional performance under exogenously assigned high workload
